objective: Nikova Raskol of Stormwind wants you to collect 10 Red Wool Bandanas.

description: Bitterness flows through my veins like a cold river.  My grandson, Mac, was such a good boy.  A mere 14 years old.  When the army was sent off to the front, Mac took up arms to defend the city.  He was a guard in The Stockade, where the Defias gang is locked up.  Mac reprimanded some of the prisoners for tearing their wool blankets to make scarves, a symbol of their gang.  For that Mac was stabbed in the back.
I want revenge.  Bring me 10 of their precious Wool Bandanas.  They are the color of blood.
progress: I see you are back, <class>. Have you collected 10 Red Wool Bandanas from those Defias Scum in The Stockade yet?
completion: So these bandanas -- filthy tokens of corruption -- are what my Mac had to die for?  Such a waste.  Such a tragic sacrifice.
But alas, I cannot return to the past.  Just know, <name>, that you have brought my family justice through your deeds.
